evidence: Carries the Wallet label, modifies core wallet debit/credit accounting in src/wallet/, and updates wallet history RPCs.
rationale: Fixes long-standing nonsensical and negative fee calculations and fabricated send entries in history RPCs for mixed-input transactions such as CoinJoins and Payjoins. As documented in issue #14136, assuming full ownership of foreign inputs produces incorrect accounting, particularly following wallet rescans or descriptor imports.
